Congo
Consular help:Consular help will be provided bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Paris, France or bythe Embassy of Bosnia and Herzegovina in Cairo, Egypt.
Visa required for the following traveling documentation for BH citizens (Visa shell be issued in Rome):
Regular passport YES Visa shall be issued in Roma.
Regular biometric passport YES
Service/Official biometric passport YES
Diplomatic biometric passport YES
Citizens of the Republic of Congo are required visas when entering, exiting or travelling through Bosnia and Herzegovina.
